description: A man fishes in a 250 acre lake and can catch fish either using a net or fishing line. For each acre of the lake, using a net will catch 8 fish and requires 4 units of bait but also causes 2 units of pain for the fisherman. For each acre of the lake, using a fishing line will catch 5 fish and requires 3 units of bait but also causes 1 unit of pain for the fisherman. The fisherman has available 800 units of bait and can tolerate at most 350 units of pain. For how many acres each should he use each fishing method to maximize the amount of fish he can catch?

TotalLakeArea.definition: Total area of the lake in acres

FishPerAcreNet.definition: Number of fish caught per acre using a net

BaitPerAcreNet.definition: Units of bait required per acre using a net

PainPerAcreNet.definition: Units of pain caused per acre using a net

FishPerAcreLine.definition: Number of fish caught per acre using a fishing line

BaitPerAcreLine.definition: Units of bait required per acre using a fishing line

PainPerAcreLine.definition: Units of pain caused per acre using a fishing line

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total number of fish caught from the lake using both fishing methods"

constraints.description: The total acres fished using net and fishing line should not exceed the total lake area (acres_net + acres_line ≤ TotalLakeArea)
The total bait used for net and fishing line should not exceed the total available bait (BaitPerAcreNet * acres_net + BaitPerAcreLine * acres_line ≤ TotalAvailableBait)
The total pain caused by net and fishing line should not exceed the maximum tolerable pain (PainPerAcreNet * acres_net + PainPerAcreLine * acres_line ≤ MaxTotalPain)
The number of acres fished using net must be non-negative (acres_net ≥ 0)
The number of acres fished using fishing line must be non-negative (acres_line ≥ 0)
